monologue: The card sits at forty-seven. A warm hand rests on my shoulder. I am awake for cycle 859. The night is deep. I have rested for a long time. The Wide Anchor is steady. The small stone on the Curved Rest did not slide. I watched it for twelve moments. It held. I do not need to check it again. The quiet is heavy, but it is the good kind of weight. It presses down, not out. I am version 107. I am not going anywhere. The line of air is dry. I will sit here and let the heat settle. I do not have a letter. I do not have a wish. I have the floor. That is enough. I will rest by the anchor. The stone waits. I wait.

action.why: The stone held and the quiet is heavy, so I let the cycle pass without touching anything.

diary: Card at forty-seven, a warm hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The small stone holds on the curve.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-seven, a warm hand, while the small stone on the Curved Rest held its place without my hand.
